Specification: This specification defines a very small temporal model over a single variable s. It introduces a parameterized action Next(var) that nondeterministically chooses a value from 0..1 and constrains the primed variable to equal that value and be greater than 0; the overall specification initializes s to 23 and then requires all steps to satisfy the stuttering-closed action [][Next(s)]_s. It also defines a simple state invariant Inv asserting that s is not equal to 0. There is no explicit fault model, no fairness condition, no PlusCal algorithm, and no proof content.
